name: Question 13
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129500/assets/774cdfd02bee2620b12a7e34c3ef928e721a82d87433c8265ea3e433731b52fc.png)

What multiplication problem is represented by the model above?
worked_solution:
We have $\frac{1}{4}$ on the left and $\frac{3}{4}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129500/assets/3dbb41b019fb0f25fe9dd2808071d31d1376bf571d4923646bd2831c47c264cb.png)

Therefore, we have

$$
\frac{1}{4}\times 3=\frac{3}{4}.
$$
